session: Dev session as intent extras (devSession, userId, role, token) against a local memory API at 10.0.2.2:3000. Files copied into the app's files folder with run-as: hill.fit (activity-hill-run.fit), export.zip (hill.fit, road.gpx, broken.fit, README.txt).
